captions.detailed: A pedestal-mounted tooling tree featuring a heavy circular base with triangular gussets supporting a tall vertical cylindrical column. Two orange articulated rotary arms are mounted at different heights on discrete dark grey clamp blocks attached to the central column. Each orange arm terminates in a small rectangular, light grey faceplate. The two branches rotate independently via revolute joints at their respective clamp blocks, allowing separate angular positioning.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery model of a pedestal-mounted two-branch tooling tree. The assembly should feature a heavy circular base with stabilizing gussets supporting a tall vertical column, two dark grey support blocks clamped at different heights and angles, and two orange rotary arms that pivot independently and end in rectangular faceplates.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a cylinder combined with extruded triangular gussets. Create the main vertical column as a tall cylinder with a flat cap. Model the support blocks as rectangular prisms with cylindrical sockets. Build the rotary arms using angled extrusions and cylinders, and cap each with a thin rectangular box for the faceplate. Assemble these components using rigid transforms and define revolute joints between the support blocks and the rotating arms.
